ISSUER_COORD/Dockerfile:
FROM node:18-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json tsconfig.json ./
COPY src ./src
RUN npm install
RUN npm run build

FROM node:18-alpine
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production
COPY --from=build /app/build ./build
COPY package*.json .
RUN npm install --production --omit=dev
COPY .env .
EXPOSE 5500
CMD ["node", "build/App/app.js"]
